findings.label: Overpass User-Agent header dropped in browser
findings.detail: fetch cannot set User-Agent (forbidden header); it is silently ignored in the browser. Harmless because the browser supplies its own UA and the retry+kumi-mirror fallback covers 406/504, but the header gives a false sense of control.

findings.label: Datum mismatch between numeric verdict and 3D occlusion
findings.detail: LOS obstacle tops use IGN ground + building height while the 3D view extrudes buildings over the terrarium DEM, so visual occlusion can differ slightly from computed clearance. Acknowledged in the plan.

findings.label: Sampling resolution can miss narrow obstacles
findings.detail: Point-in-polygon runs at 200 samples (~42 m apart), so a thin building footprint between samples is not counted. Acceptable approximation; raise N or add segment-polygon intersection for more precision.

findings.label: Large single Overpass fetch and O(buildings x samples) scan
findings.detail: ~10.7 MB / ~10790 polygons x 200 samples in the browser; bbox pre-filter mitigates but first-load cost/memory are non-trivial. Narrow the corridor if performance suffers.

findings.label: GitHub Pages deployment bundled in
findings.detail: HEAD commit adds .github/workflows/pages.yml, CNAME, and .nojekyll, unrelated to the LOS logic. Harmless static hosting.
